Email notification service

You can subscribe to our email notification service to receive an email alert relating to specific rules, airspace, airworthiness and various other categories.

Receive updates relating to Rules and Advisory Circulars, safety education publications, emerging technologies, media releases, and other general categories. You can also sign up for the CAA Briefing - our quarterly newsletter.
